column1: 2.3.1.1 MB2-Front End Assy. To receive the RF signal in 6-18 GHz band, Front-end
Unit (MB2) is configured with two Front-end (MB2) modules and two sectoral horn
antennae for covering 180 sector. This module intercepts the radar threat signals of slant,
vertical, horizontal and circular polarizations from the environment through two
independent sectoral horn antenna switch polarizer embedded Radome having minimum
gain of 7 dB, each covering an angle of 90 X 10, in the frequency range of 6-18 GHz.
